```{=html}
<section class="hero" aria-labelledby="hero-name">

    <img src="img/saeed-salehi.jpg" width="640" height="960" alt="Portrait of Saeed Salehi">

    <p id="hero-name" class="hero-name" role="heading" aria-level="1">Saeed Salehi</p>
    <p class="hero-role">Associate Professor of Fluid Mechanics, Docent</p>
    <p class="hero-affil">Division of Applied Thermodynamics and Fluid Mechanics · Department of Management and Engineering · Linköping University, Sweden</p>
    <p class="hero-intro">I study complex fluid flows with high-fidelity computational fluid dynamics (CFD), and combine it with data-driven methods and machine learning to build efficient and reliable tools for simulation, reduced-order modelling, flow control and uncertainty quantification. The applications range from canonical flows to turbomachinery and energy systems.</p>
    <p class="hero-intro">I am first and foremost a CFD specialist and an active OpenFOAM developer. My current focus is deep reinforcement learning for active flow control, coupled directly to the flow solver.</p>
  </div>
</section>
```
